agent_note: Story collection, so quotes span several narrators; the dominant stance across event quotes is retrospective past (17 of 18). A minority present-tense strand is visible in q08934 ('Later it will occur to him') and in the present thought tag of q08951 ('Wilson thinks'), consistent with one or more separately present-tense pieces rather than a dual/diary structure. Heavy aphorism load: 23 of 48 quotes are gnomic, plus one author's-note paratext -- Goodreads selection bias is severe for this book.
